plugins.name: verify-cycle
plugins.description: The verify role's state machine: idle -> reproducing -> reproduced -> cleared. Adversarial reproduction of defects coding and qa may have missed, gated by transition-rules.md; blocking findings addressed to coding are not overridden by a clean review-record.

plugins.name: verify-agent-env
plugins.description: One-install environment bundle for the verify role: installs verify-cycle via dependency. Contains no code of its own.
